item.subject: science
item.stem:
On a hot afternoon in a village in Rajasthan, Meena notices dark thunderclouds forming over the heated fields near her home.
Which sequence correctly explains how the thunderstorm develops?

options.A: Rain clouds become heavy and simply fall to the ground as rain.
options.B: The heated land warms the moist air above it, the warm air rises creating a low-pressure area, cooler air flows in, and the rising moist air cools and condenses into clouds and rain.
options.C: Cool air from the surroundings sinks over the fields, pushes the warm air down, and squeezes rain out of the clouds.
options.D: The sun heats the clouds directly until the water vapour in them turns into rain.
